description.text: Definition of the Submodel Asset Interfaces Description identified by its semanticId.
Indicates the entry point for a particular asset interface
Provides a human-readable title to give a human-readable context of the interface.
Provides the metadata of the asset’s endpoint (base, content type that is used for interaction, etc)
Defines asset connection entry point. Each protocol specifies a base pattern. Please see Annex B.1 of the AID document for more details.
Defines content type based on a media type (e.g., text/plain) and potential character decoding/encoding type (e.g., charset=utf-8) for the media type (see RFC2046) of the whole interface
Selects one or more of the security scheme(s) that can be applied at runtime from the collection of security schemes defines in securityDefinitions.
Defines the security scheme according to W3C:
Provides the metadata of the actually interfaces such as which datapoints and functions are provided by the properties, actions, and events interaction abstraction.
Collection of asset’s datapoint definitions as property SMC
Collection of functions that can be done on asset as action SMC
An invokable function of the asset (WoT ActionAffordance).
Provides a human-readable title to give a human-readable context of the interface.
The result of the action arrives in the reply to the invocation. Absent: unknown.
An arbitrary command
Names of the members of this object that must be present.
Indicates the abstract data type (one of object, array, string, number, integer, boolean, or null) of the described datapoint
Provides a human-readable title of this interaction (e.g., display a text for UI representation)
Nested definitions of a datapoint. Only applicable if type=object.
Defines a data element within an object-based datapoint.
Optional element when the idShort of {property_name} cannot be used to reflect the desired property name due to the idShort restrictions (e.g., payload message uses “temperature-value” as key term).
Indicates the abstract data type (one of object, array, string, number, integer, boolean, or null) of the described datapoint
Contains information about datapoint resource location.
Target IRI relative path or full IRI of asset’s datapoint. The relative endpoint definition in href is always relative to base defined in EndpointMetadata
Defined the level of guarantee for message delivery between clients.
